description: Réseaux interurbains dans le Puy de Dôme (GTFS ROUTE)- Ville de Clermont-Ferrand is a dataset listed in Open Data Clermont-Ferrand, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Région Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. Ce jeu de données rassemble les données route: Réseau interurbain du Puy-de-Dôme Réseau interurbain Cars Région Express La donnée a été filtrée pour ne garder que les transports circulant dans le département du Puy de Dôme. Coverage: Clermont-Ferrand. The portal files it under Mobilités - Transports. Its keywords are gtfs, autocars, transport, arret, ligne, urbain. The portal shows 578 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (https://www.opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermont-ferrand-fr-portal.
